label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP. The sink expression is connectHttpByHostname(host) which constructs a URL using the host variable ('http://' + host) and initiates an outbound connection. The host variable is populated directly from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although there is a guard checking isNonPublicAddress(resolveHost(host)), this only blocks private/internal IPs. An attacker can supply a public hostname (e.g., google.com), which passes the check, resulting in the server initiating an HTTP request to an attacker-controlled destination. This constitutes Server-Side Request Forgery.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to host variable
Outbound connection made to host without sufficient validation against public targets
